work.englishTitle: MAXQ Special Edition Vol. 8: Jo Aera
work.summary: Digital MAXQ Special Edition featuring Korean Pilates instructor and online fitness creator Jo Aera (조애라). RIDI identifies the exact Vol. 8 product and describes the series as selected MAXQ pictorials previously unreleased online. A 2023 interview identifies her Instagram profile @aerassam_; later professional profiles document her online teaching and creator activity. Photo overlap with her other MAXQ/Secret B shoots is unverified, so no image uniqueness is asserted. Bibliographic metadata only; no cover or paid PDF copied.
